b1-18-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A New Law
b1-18-01.scenario: You are Meg. In your class at the university in Budapest you have read a news story about a new law. Carlos phones from his office and asks what happened to it. Parliament approved it.
b1-18-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what happened to the law and who did it.
cues: Say what happened to the law
b1-18-01.target: La ley fue aprobada por el Parlamento.
b1-18-01.english: The law was approved by Parliament.
b1-18-01.canDo: I can describe how public processes and government actions work.

b1-18-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Public Transport
b1-18-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Over dinner in your flat in Budapest, Meg asks what you think the city government should do. You think public transport needs work.
b1-18-02.prompt: Tell Meg what the government should improve, using an expression of advisability.
cues: Say it is advisable that something happens
Say what the government should improve
b1-18-02.target: Conviene que el Gobierno mejore el transporte público.
b1-18-02.english: It is advisable that the government improve public transport.
b1-18-02.canDo: I can discuss what governments should do.

b1-18-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Costly Proposal
b1-18-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos shows you a news article about a proposal for a new service in Budapest. You like the proposal, but the service would be very expensive.
b1-18-03.prompt: Give Carlos your opinion of the proposal and say what worries you.
cues: Give your opinion of the proposal
Say what worries you about the price
b1-18-03.target: Creo que la propuesta es positiva. Me parece preocupante que el servicio sea tan caro.
b1-18-03.english: I think the proposal is positive. It seems worrying to me that the service is so expensive.
b1-18-03.canDo: I can express and evaluate political opinions.

b1-18-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Careful Yes
b1-18-04.scenario: You are Carlos. At a neighbourhood debate in Budapest, Meg, who is studying there, asks whether you agree with a proposal. You do agree, but you think it may be hard to carry out.
b1-18-04.prompt: Tell Meg that you agree, and then qualify your view.
cues: Say that you agree with the proposal
Add a difficulty with a contrast
b1-18-04.target: Estoy de acuerdo con la propuesta. Sin embargo, puede ser difícil aplicarla.
b1-18-04.english: I agree with the proposal. However, it may be difficult to implement it.
b1-18-04.canDo: I can participate in a public debate.

b1-18-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Facundo and the Caudillos
b1-18-05.scenario: You are Meg. For a class in Budapest you read a retelling of Sarmiento's book about Facundo Quiroga. Carlos asks what the text says.
b1-18-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what the text says about the caudillo and what changed with time.
cues: Say what happened to those who did not obey
Say what was organised with time
b1-18-05.target: Facundo era un caudillo. Se castigaba al que no obedecía. Con el tiempo se organizaron elecciones.
b1-18-05.english: Facundo was a caudillo. Whoever did not obey was punished. With time, elections were organised.
b1-18-05.canDo: I can contribute to a public meeting.

b1-18-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Neighbourhood Meeting
b1-18-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. At a neighbourhood meeting in Budapest, Meg asks what you think of a new plan. You like it, but you want the people to look at other options too.
b1-18-consolidation.prompt: Give your opinion, add a contrast and recommend an action.
cues: Give your opinion of the plan
b1-18-consolidation.target: Creo que la propuesta es buena; sin embargo, es necesario que estudiemos otras opciones.
b1-18-consolidation.english: I think the proposal is good; however, it is necessary that we study other options.
b1-18-consolidation.canDo: I can consolidate political and public-life vocabulary.
